claims.statement: THE LOOP (src/flow/semantic-driver.ts, L2): every turn re-reads the derived JSON (advance + look-back + goal), the model proposes ONE call, validateProposal checks it against the CLOSED SET (reads: next/goal/gates/check/verify/detail; writes: submit! the present act, run! the frame), and accepted calls execute IN-PROCESS through the same command layer (commands.* reads, commands.submit!, the Frame) — no shell, no CLI spawn, no raw write, no free-form call. BOUNDED: maxTurns (out of range refused, never clamped), a ROUTE REASON on every stop, a CHECKPOINT at every human gate, resume by re-derivation (a handed-back checkpoint is compared to the fresh derivation; a mismatch is recorded and nothing is replayed). Tests: src/flow/__tests__/semantic-driver.test.ts (32 tests: reads, run! happy path, model stop, refusal by name, turn bound, gates, boundary draft, provider failure, resume) + src/e2e/drive.e2e.test.ts (4 tests over POST /api/drive with a local stub provider).

NEVER ANSWERS A GATE, NEVER SELF-CLOSES. The driver deps carry NO interact ability: the loop builds its OWN present-only channel, so deciding a gate is unrepresentable rather than merely forbidden. submit! opens a gate and LANDS there; run! pre-flights an undecided entry gate by submitting it (the PRESENT act) and landing; a live gate decision inside the frame throws DriverGateRefused and lands the run there. A proposal naming gate!/evidence!/capture!/complete!/spawn!/spec!/append!/goal!/advance! is refused forbidden-call BY NAME with its reason, executes nothing and writes nothing (the event log is byte-identical). Asserted: no run writes a confirmed/rejected/completed the human did not make; the only confirmed event in a run fixture is the human grill accept.

THE AUTHORED-WORK BOUNDARY DRAFTS. At advance-leg/closure-needed the driver makes ONE draft turn: buildDraft validates the task id (v15 grammar + the leg next-free prefix) and the contract against the exported CONTRACT_FIELDS plus store.contractProblems — the SAME field set and checklist spawn! enforces — and returns a GENERATED draft that carries model/provider/turn/runId in its label, grounded on the epic + the goal + the upstream artifacts, with the exact human act (spawn!, then submit! grill) and ZERO writes; a draft that fails validation stops draft-invalid with the problems named and is never offered. spawn! is not in the closed set (forbidden-call). At none the driver presents the derived goal consult and STOPS (design Q3): no draft, no provider call, zero writes.

CREDENTIALS + FAILURE. The provider and its key are resolved server-side in src/surface/drive.ts; only the wrapped LlmAbility reaches the loop, and the unit tests assert no key/ANN_LLM_API_KEY appears in the run result. The e2e starts the service with ANN_LLM_API_KEY planted and asserts the key appears in NO response body (the drive bodies plus every read and the served page) and in no op-log line — while proving the loop really completed against the stub provider. A provider failure (the ability throwing) is a NAMED stop (provider-failure) with ZERO writes: no fabricated call, no fabricated draft; the boundary-draft path fails the same way. PROVENANCE: every write the driver itself lands carries RECORDED_BY plus the driver run in the event note (asserted).

NO NEW WRITE PATH. The driver adds NO new command and no cross-folder writer: it composes the existing L1 writers in-process (commands.submit! — confined to the addressed node — and the Frame, whose writers are the sanctioned ones), so the write-confinement invariant is unchanged and nothing was named-before-existence.
